newsitem.title: USA: Discount Auto says it will fight suit.
newsitem.headline: Discount Auto says it will fight suit.

text.p: Discount Auto Parts Inc said on Thursday it would fight a $20 million lawsuit filed against it and one of its employees by Airgas Inc of Pennsylvania.

"We believe the allegations in the lawsuit are without merit and intend to defend vigorously against them," said Peter Fontaine, chairman and chief executive officer of Discount Auto Parts, said in news release.

The lawsuit, filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Georgia, Savannah Division, alleges conspiracy to defraud and RICO violations in connection with commercial sales of refrigerant R-12 (freon) in October and November 1996, the company said.

"Airgas has apparently tried to shift blame and financial responsibility to us," Fontaine said, "perhaps because Refrigeration Station Inc, Airgas' freon supplier, has filed for protection under federal bankruptcy laws."
Discount Auto Parts has said in the past that Refrigeration Station is in bankruptcy and under federal investigation. ((-- Miami newsroom, 305-374-5013))
